plan.title: Fix spec/prd render tasks to resolve xbrief layout (#2132)

narratives.Description: After the xbrief/ -> xbrief/ rename (#2109), spec:validate, spec:render, and prd:render task fragments hardcode the legacy xbrief/specification.xbrief.json path. On migrated xbrief/ trees the path does not exist, causing all three tasks to fail. Fix by routing through the existing layout resolver (resolveSpecArtifactPath) so migrated trees use xbrief/specification.xbrief.json and unmigrated trees fall back to xbrief/specification.xbrief.json.
